question: How should a practitioner worship the god of love in this rite?
premises: A practitioner is enjoined to perform worship.
The worship is directed to the god of love.
Offerings include fragrance, flowers, and similar items.
inference: One who worships the god of love should do so with fragrance, flowers, and other offerings.
plain_english: Thus, whoever would worship the god of love should do so with fragrance, flowers, and other offerings.
